description.text:
Origin (源) is one of the two booster packs of Sword & Shield: Nine Colours Gathering (九彩汇聚), alongside Friend (朋). Nine Colours Gathering was the fourth Sword & Shield booster release in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 1 March 2024 in 5- and 25-card packs. It brought the third battle style, Fusion Strike (汇流), whose cards draw on the strength of the other Fusion Strike Pokémon in play, and the Dragon type, last seen in the Sun & Moon series, came back to the game.

Origin holds the Fusion Strike cards, each marked in its top right corner: Mew V and Mew VMAX, the release's cover Pokémon, whose Cross Fusion Strike can use an attack of a benched Fusion Strike Pokémon; Genesect V, whose Ability lets you draw until your hand matches the number of Fusion Strike Pokémon you have in play; Fusion Strike Energy; and the Supporter Elesa's Sparkle. Its Dragon cards include Rayquaza V and VMAX, with the Stadium Stormy Mountains, and it also has Gengar V and VMAX. Its main cards are numbered out of 132; full-art, Character Super Rare, rainbow and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 177.
